comment: The preloaded-intermediates list every job of ci.yml launches with (STEALTHFOX_INTERMEDIATES, set at the top of the workflow): EMPTY (format 1, no certificates), the same bytes as the wrapper's ci/intermediates.json, so no job asks Mozilla for the real list (the core neither downloads nor checks when the variable is set). To change it, change ci/intermediates.json and sha256 here in one commit; tests/test_ci_sets_the_intermediates_list.py fails when they differ.
